item.title: Version 1.32.1
item.description:
New

  • Screenshot annotation tools — draw arrows, shapes, and text overlays directly on screenshots with a dedicated annotation toolbar and compositing engine
  • Screenshot inspector redesign — unified layers-based UI with shared design system for consistency with the video editor
  • Menu bar view — new dedicated menu bar popover with recording status, quick actions, and keyboard shortcuts

Improved

  • Record More now preserves webcam and microphone tracks — additional clips properly carry over webcam video and microphone audio, with automatic audio concatenation across clips
  • Timeline playhead rendering performance — playhead updates at 60fps via a dedicated PlayheadClock observable, while the rest of the timeline throttles to ~10fps, eliminating expensive full-timeline re-renders during playback
  • Dashboard and capture selector UI cleanup
  • Add Track modal redesigned
  • Improved Sentry breadcrumb logging across recording and editing flows

Fixed

  • App hangs caused by AVPlayer currentTime() polling blocking the main thread — replaced with addPeriodicTimeObserver (DEBUT-APP-2E)
  • App hangs from synchronous XPC calls during camera/microphone device discovery — moved AVCaptureDevice.DiscoverySession to a background thread (DEBUT-APP-22)
  • Recording service work moved off the main thread to prevent UI stalls
  • Issue with preview frame rate
